title: Introduction to Media Handling
overview: Expo provides libraries to work with images, videos, audio, and other media features in mobile applications.

example.title: Media Flow
example.content:
User
 ↓
Select Media
 ↓
Expo Media API
 ↓
Display / Process Media

title: Image Picker
overview: Expo Image Picker allows users to select images and videos from the device gallery or capture them using the camera.

title: Displaying Images
overview: Images can be displayed using React Native Image component with local assets or remote URLs.

title: Audio Playback
overview: Expo Audio provides tools to play, control, and manage audio files inside applications.

title: Video Playback
overview: Expo applications can play videos using available media libraries and control playback behavior.

title: Media Permissions
overview: Media access requires user permissions before accessing camera, gallery, microphone, or storage features.

example.title: Permission Flow
example.content:
Request Permission
 ↓
User Approval
 ↓
Access Media

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how Expo handles images, audio, videos, media selection, and required permissions.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ Image Picker selects media.
✔ Audio manages sound.
✔ Video handles playback.
✔ Permissions protect user privacy.
